name: Blue Bayou Restaurant
description: The most atmospheric and beloved restaurant in theme park history — Blue Bayou is a magical bayou-side restaurant situated literally inside the Pirates of the Caribbean attraction, where guests dine on the moonlit bayou as boats drift past them into the ride. One of the most extraordinary and sought-after dining experiences at any theme park in the world. Advance reservations essential.

items.name: Monte Cristo Sandwich
items.description: The legendary Blue Bayou Monte Cristo — fried sandwich with turkey, ham and powdered sugar

items.name: Jambalaya
items.description: Classic New Orleans jambalaya with shrimp, chicken andouille and Creole rice

items.name: Creole Seafood Gumbo
items.description: Rich dark roux gumbo with shrimp, crab and andouille sausage

items.name: Mint Julep
items.description: Classic New Orleans mint julep

name: Carnation Cafe
description: A Disneyland original since 1955 — Carnation Cafe is a charming Main Street USA outdoor cafe serving classic American comfort food including pot roast, burgers, pancakes and the legendary Monte Cristo sandwich in the most nostalgic and atmospheric dining setting at Disneyland. One of the most beloved restaurants at any Disney park.

items.name: Pot Roast
items.description: Classic slow-braised beef pot roast with mashed potatoes and gravy

items.name: Mickey Waffles
items.description: Classic Mickey-shaped waffles with fresh berries and whipped cream

items.name: Cheeseburger
items.description: Carnation classic cheeseburger with fries

items.name: Hot Chocolate
items.description: Rich creamy Carnation hot chocolate

name: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe
description: A beautifully Mary Poppins-themed bakery cafe on Main Street USA serving outstanding pastries, sandwiches, soups and coffee — the Jolly Holiday is the most charming and atmospheric quick-service dining option at Disneyland and the best spot for breakfast or afternoon tea on Main Street.

items.name: Turkey Pesto Focaccia
items.description: Roasted turkey with pesto aioli on toasted focaccia

items.name: Strawberry Rose Macaron
items.description: Classic French macaron in strawberry rose flavour

items.name: Tomato Soup
items.description: Classic creamy tomato basil soup with sourdough bread

items.name: Cappuccino
items.description: Perfectly made Italian cappuccino

name: Plaza Inn
description: A Disneyland original serving fried chicken since 1955 — Plaza Inn is a beautiful Victorian-themed restaurant at the end of Main Street USA serving the most famous and beloved fried chicken at any Disney park, alongside classic American comfort food. One of the most historically significant restaurants at Disneyland.

items.name: Fried Chicken
items.description: The legendary Plaza Inn fried chicken with mashed potatoes and gravy

items.name: Pasta Primavera
items.description: Fresh pasta with seasonal vegetables and cream sauce

items.name: Caesar Salad
items.description: Classic Caesar with romaine, croutons and parmesan

items.name: Apple Pie
items.description: Classic American apple pie with vanilla ice cream

name: Bengal Barbecue
description: A beloved Adventureland quick-service landmark — Bengal Barbecue serves skewered meats and vegetables grilled over charcoal in a beautifully themed jungle setting adjacent to the Jungle Cruise. The most popular quick-service food in Adventureland and famous for its Outpost Skewers.

items.name: Outpost Chicken Skewer
items.description: Marinated chicken grilled over charcoal on a bamboo skewer

items.name: Beef Skewer
items.description: Seasoned beef grilled over charcoal on a bamboo skewer

items.name: Vegetable Skewer
items.description: Seasonal vegetables grilled over charcoal

items.name: Tiger Tail Breadstick
items.description: Classic Bengal BBQ tiger tail seasoned breadstick
